paragraphs: Rabbi Petroki, brother of Rabbi Derosa.

He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Yoma ch. 4, halakhah 4, where he says [a statement] in the name of Rabbi Ba bar Bena. And so the statement is brought in Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:8: Rabbi Petroki, brother of Rabbi Derosa, in the name of Rabbi Abba bar Kuna.

In Bamidbar Rabbah 12:4, Rabbi Petroki, brother of Rabbi Derosai, reports Rabbi Ve’ibo Abba. Hyman calls this a scribal error and proposes “in the name of Rabbi Abba bar Avina”; he notes that Seder HaDorot, in its Rabbi Afteriki entry, did not notice this.

notes.text: Hyman’s proposed Abba bar Avina correction is retained as his. The checked Bamidbar Rabbah 12:4 excerpt has Petriki, Derosai and Ayyvu Abba, differing from his supplied forms.

The consulted Torat Emet Bamidbar Rabbah12:4 names Petriki, brother of Derosai, in Rabbi Ayyvu Abba’s name. This bounded complete saying was checked; Hyman’s proposed Abba bar Avina correction remains his and does not establish a merged chain.
